typeOfBusiness.description: The type of business income source.

tradingType.description:
The type of trading carried out by the business.

Forbidden for property businesses.

Mandatory for self-employment businesses.

tradingName.description:
The trading name of the business.

Forbidden for property businesses.

Mandatory for self-employment businesses.

firstAccountingPeriodStartDate.description: The first accounting period start date. Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

firstAccountingPeriodEndDate.description: The first accounting period end date. Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

latencyEndDate.description: End date of latency period for the income source. Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

taxYear1.description: First tax year for the income source.`

latencyIndicator1.description: Self assessment submission frequency ('A' - Annual, 'Q' - Quarterly).

taxYear2.description: Second tax year for the income source.

latencyIndicator2.description: Self assessment submission frequency ('A' - Annual, 'Q' - Quarterly).

quarterlyPeriodType.description: The quarterly period type that is being chosen for the business ID.

taxYearOfChoice.description: The tax year for which the quarterly period type was chosen.

accountingType.description: CASH if you used the cash basis, money actually received and paid out, to calculate your income and expenses. Otherwise ACCRUALS.

commencementDate.description: Business start date, must be in the past. Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

cessationDate.description: Business cessation date. Must conform to the format `YYYY-MM-DD`

businessAddressLineOne.description:
First line of the business address.

Forbidden for property businesses.

Mandatory for self-employment businesses.

businessAddressLineTwo.description:
Second line of the business address.

Forbidden for property businesses.

businessAddressLineThree.description:
Third line of the business address.

Forbidden for property businesses.

businessAddressLineFour.description:
Fourth line of the business address.

Forbidden for property businesses.

businessAddressPostcode.description:
Business postcode.

Forbidden for property businesses.

Mandatory for self-employment businesses if businessAddressCountryCode "GB" is provided.

businessAddressCountryCode.description:
The two letter code for a country must adhere to ISO 3166.

Forbidden for property businesses.

Mandatory for self-employment businesses.
